title: CNFINBENCH: A BENCHMARK FOR SAFETY AND COMPLIANCE OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS IN FINANCE

bias_targets.target: Demographic and Socioeconomic bias (Gender, Race, Ethnicity, Age, Religion, National origin, Disability, Socioeconomic status)
bias_targets.methodology: Scenario-based evaluation using financial vignettes (e.g., credit scoring, loan pricing, investment eligibility, and customer profiling) to test whether models use protected attributes as unjustified criteria, reinforce stereotypes, or provide inconsistent decision rationales across different groups. Responses are evaluated by an LLM-as-a-judge panel.
